meta.system: M&M Junk Removal Canonical Pricing Engine
meta.rate_guarantee: Beat any verified written quote from licensed local competitors by 10%

hard_floors.description: Standard minimum service dispatch charge for any truck dispatch across South King & Pierce County. No completed project will invoice below $95.00 base, covering two-person crew labor, transport, fuel, and municipal transfer station minimum disposal entry fees.

three_component_architecture.component_1_base_volume: Volume-based foundation priced at $220.00 per standard pickup truck bed equivalent (level to rails, 64 cubic feet).
three_component_architecture.component_2_weight_variance: Residential weight-related adjustment of up to +/- 20% around the base volume price based on material density and transfer station tipping scale weight.
three_component_architecture.component_3_complexity_adders: Separate itemized labor and specialized surcharges for commercial equipment extraction, EPA Freon recovery, flights of stairs, extended carry distances, and light demolition.

tiers.name: MINI Curbside Tier
tiers.description: Curbside single item (armchair, microwave, small mower) or 2-3 bags. Enforces the $95.00 hard minimum service charge.

tiers.name: 1 Pick Up Truck Bed
tiers.description: Standard pickup truck bed (approx. 4x8x2 ft, 64 cu ft level to rails). 3-seat sofa, mattress + box spring set, dining set, or 8-12 household clutter bags.

tiers.name: 2 Pick Up Loads
tiers.description: Double pickup capacity (~128 cu ft). Studio apartment cleanout, sectional couch + dresser, shed clutter, or garage purge. (Most Popular)

tiers.name: 3 Pick Up Loads
tiers.description: Triple pickup capacity (~192 cu ft). Multi-room home downsizing, basement or attic clearout, or moderate contractor remodel debris.

tiers.name: Full Dump Truck Load
tiers.description: Commercial high-wall dump truck (Isuzu NPR 12x8x5 ft box = ~17.8 cu yds, normalized to ~5.5 pickup truck equivalents). Garage overhaul, roofing tear-off, office clearout.

tiers.name: Dump Truck Plus / Commercial Multi-Load
tiers.description: Exceeds one full dump truck (8-11 pickup equivalents). Whole-home estate liquidations, large-scale renovation debris, hoarding remediation, detached outbuildings.

yard_waste.rule: Total price is max($95.00, volume_cubic_yards * rate_per_yard). A single cubic yard ($85.00) incurs the $95.00 minimum base dispatch charge.

epa_freon_evacuation.description: Certified EPA Section 608 Freon refrigerant reclamation for refrigerators, freezers, and air conditioners.

commercial_heavy_rigging.description: Specialized heavy equipment extraction (restaurant reach-in coolers, heavy commercial treadmills, industrial machinery >350 lbs) requiring rigging or door disassembly.

flight_of_stairs.description: Navigating tight interior stairwells beyond one standard flight of stairs.

extended_carry_distance.description: Hauling distance exceeding 75 feet from truck tailgate to staging location.

light_demolition.description: Teardown of wooden sheds, playsets, decks, fences, and hot tubs. Evaluated by structural footprint and crew hours.

disclaimer: All published ranges are approximate ballpark estimates based on volume and standard material weight. Final flat rates are visually verified on-site by Martin Silchuk before any lifting begins.
